# Roy Gardner

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 ch.Charming P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 ch.Dawn P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017)</sub>

## Appearance

Roy is described as being adorably handsome. He has glorious dark eyes along with a deep, black, velvety smile.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 ch.Charming P48](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0048), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 ch.Confidences P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036)_

## Personality

Roy Gardner is described as adorably handsome, clever, and perfectly sweet even in the face of disappointment. He possesses an unfailing, deferential courtesy alongside a delightful, pleading voice, though he is also seen as a melancholy and inscrutable figure who struggles to perceive the humorous side of things.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 ch.Confidences P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036)_

## History

Roy Gardner was forced to leave college two years prior to travel abroad with his ailing, widowed mother. After returning, he rescued [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during a November storm, fulfilling her vision of an ideal hero and sending her roses afterward. Roy began courting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), attending a college reception with her and arranging for his family to visit her prior to graduation. Following graduation, Roy proposed to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on a walk, but she realized she did not love him and rejected his proposal.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P27](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0027), [v3 ch.Charming P29](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0029), [v3 ch.Charming P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036), [v3 ch.Charming P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042), [v3 ch.Charming P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 ch.Christine P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), +10 more_

## Quotes

> "That ought to be sufficient introduction. My name is Royal Gardner. And you are the Miss Shirley who read the Tennyson paper at the Philomathic the other evening, aren’t you?"
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Charming P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036)

> "I feel as if I didn’t belong anywhere yet. I put in my Freshman and Sophomore years at Redmond two years ago. I’ve been in Europe ever since. Now I’ve come back to finish my Arts course."
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Charming P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038)

> "I can’t understand it—I can’t believe you are not the woman I’ve believed you to be. But reproaches are idle between us. You are the only woman I can ever love. I thank you for your friendship, at least. Good-bye, Anne."
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Dawn P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032)

> "So we are classmates as well as collegemates. I am reconciled to the loss of the years that the locust has eaten,"
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Charming P40](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0040)

> "Pardon me—may I offer you the shelter of my umbrella?"
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Charming P28](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0028)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--roy-gardner.md)

Roy Gardner pursues a romantic relationship with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), who is flattered by his attention and briefly mistakes her feelings for love. The two spend time together attending college events and walking, though tension arises when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) privately feels unsettled by rumors regarding [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and chooses to wear Gilbert's flowers over Roy's at [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation). When Roy ultimately proposes to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) during a walk after graduation, she realizes she does not love him and rejects his proposal.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Christine P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Christine P12](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0012), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), +15 more_

- Romantically involved with — flattered fancy that was mistaken for love  <sub>[v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 ch.Confidences P35](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0035), [v3 ch.Evening P22](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0022), +2 more</sub>

### [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dorothy--roy-gardner.md)

[Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) is Roy Gardner's sister. Along with the rest of the Gardner family, she visits [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) after Roy arranges for his family to meet her, arriving a day earlier than anticipated.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021), +3 more_
